items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: the first one to leave Walter Page's band was Jimmie Rushing, the vocalist, because he and Fathead with McKinney Cotton Pickers, they sounded alike if you'd turn your back.

ctx.x: Oh, I mean you said the first one that left Bennie Moten's band -
No, no, no, no, the first one to leave Walter Page's band was Jimmie Rushing, the vocalist, because he and Fathead with McKinney Cotton Pickers, they sounded alike if you'd turn your back.
Who was Walter Page's piano player?
